title: Timed deathban
description: This plugin makes it so every time a player dies he gets banned. It scales, and it goes from 8 hours to 24, then 48, then a week and then permanently. it also drops the player's head in the last death.
body:
A plugin that temporarily bans players upon death temporarily. It scales upon every death (8 hours, 24 hours, 48 hours, a week, forever). On the final death, a special message is broadcasted and the player drops its head.
It also features commands to revert the settings:
/deathban check <player> -> see a player’s current death count and what their next death will cost
/deathban set <player> <count> -> manually set a player’s death count
/deathban reset <player> -> reset a player’s death count to zero (does not unban)
/deathban revive <player> -> reset death count AND unban in one command (your appeals tool)
Theres also a bypass for OPs
